4863-5289-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Revolutionist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-6798-8179.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-6798-8179.description:
Cast Generous Revival by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Generous Revival.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Generous Revival, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Generous Revival copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.

Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.

Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Maestros Diabolist as attackers.

Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

4153-6575-6791--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4153-6575-6791--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Felidar Retreat triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
